text:
claire: Quick flag 1 users hitting soft-429s from the quickstart when they run multiple paginated workers. Repro looks like naive fire-and-forget over paginator.
omar: Yeah saw that. People copy the quickstart and do: for await page -> spawn Task/process without bounding. Bursts exhaust pool then retries amplify it.
jin: Also found a subtle bug: when our JS SDK retries on 429 we used to schedule backoff without releasing the local slot first. So the client keeps thinking the slot is occupied while it sleeps -> oversubscribe.
claire: Two fixes: 1) change quickstart to show bounded concurrency pattern with try/finally, 2) SDK change to decrement counters on all error/retry paths and make Release idempotent.
odocs-bot: Note: Python has AsyncLimiter pattern in docs. JS lacked an official helper.
omar: I'd add an opt-in backpressure helper in SDKs (maxConcurrent, smoothingMs) and a small wrapper .wrap(fn) so quickstarts can show both explicit finally and the helper.
jin: Tests: unit sim with intermittent 429s asserting inflight <= max + 1; auth refresh failure mid-retry should free slots. CI: branch `hotfix/limiter-guard` queued.
ci-bot: CI queued for `hotfix/limiter-guard`.
claire: I'll update quickstart and docs; Omar & Jin, can you pair on the SDK patch? We'll publish a short onboarding note once patch cuts.
omar: On it 1 pairing this afternoon.
jin: I'll add telemetry for client.inflight and a console warning if inflight > max for >15s. That'll help distinguish bursts vs leaks.
